name: contract_vd_version_mismatch
description: Contract test for the VD feed_offset gate (vdScanLane.cpp): a Linux fleet sends VDFirst sessions with a deliberately wrong Start.feed_offset (1 -- far below any real CVE feed cursor, so it mismatches regardless of what the target's actual current offset is), and every one of them must be rejected with 409 {"error":"version_mismatch","current_version":N} without ever reaching the scanner. Distinct from checksum_reconcile.json's 409 (checksum_mismatch, a ModuleCheck contract) -- this one is VD-specific and carries a different body shape. concurrent_agents is 1 (not 0) deliberately: the offset check runs INSIDE the scan lane worker (after admission), so firing every agent at once would contend with the lane's own capacity gate (contract_vd_saturation's contract, 1 worker + 2 queue slots by default) and could shed some sessions with a bare 503 before they ever reach the offset check this scenario exists to pin.
